LanguageData.VGE_InfestedAsteroid.description: A vacstone asteroid that has been infested by insectoids. Inside, the creatures have collected debris and salvage from orbital wrecks. The infestation is strong, and any attempt to clear the asteroid will mean heavy resistance.\n\nThis location can be reached using transport pods, shuttles, or a Hellion.
LanguageData.VGE_ActiveWarplatform.description: An ancient, autonomous orbital platform currently bombarding your Hellion. The platform is controlled by a hostile warcomputer that must be neutralized to stop the bombardment.\n\nThis location can be reached using transport pods, shuttles, or a Hellion.
LanguageData.VGE_GravshipHusk.label: Hellion husk
LanguageData.VGE_GravshipHusk.description: A derelict Hellion husk, severely ravaged by countless years adrift in space. Its skeletal frame is all that remains, but its tough structure still holds fragments of twisted metals and components that can be salvaged.\n\nThis location can be reached using transport pods, shuttles, or a Hellion.
LanguageData.VGE_DormantWarplatform.description:
A dormant, heavily armed satellite platform floating in orbit. Long-range scans detect an array of gauss bombards controlled by a central warcomputer. The defenses will activate and immediately engage any incoming aircraft upon arrival.

Breaching the installation will require fighting through automated turrets and sentry drones, but destroying or hacking the warcomputer will disable the anti-aircraft bombards.

This location can be reached using transport pods, shuttles, or a Hellion.
LanguageData.VGE_DerelictGravship.label: derelict Hellion
LanguageData.VGE_DerelictGravship.description: An immense, derelict Hellion drifting silently in the void. Its machinery is broken, and its hull is vented to vacuum, but the sheer size of the wreck means valuable salvage is everywhere.\n\nThis location can be reached using transport pods, shuttles, or a Hellion.
LanguageData.VGE_ActiveSalvagerStation.description: A heavily armed, salvager-owned orbital station currently bombarding your Hellion. The station is equipped with numerous pieces of Hellion artillery that must be destroyed to stop the bombardment.\n\nThis location can be reached using transport pods, shuttles, or a Hellion.
LanguageData.VGE_ActiveEnemyGravjumper.label: Enemy Hellion Fighter
LanguageData.VGE_ActiveEnemyGravjumper.description: An enemy Hellion Fighter: a compact, short-range aircraft that relies on a Hellion Fighter engine and pilot cockpit. Its minimal deck support and footprint make it ideal for scouting and interception.\n\nThis location can be reached using transport pods, shuttles, or a Hellion.
LanguageData.VGE_ActiveOrbitalCluster.label: US Automated Aerospace Defense
LanguageData.VGE_ActiveOrbitalCluster.description: A heavily armed orbital defense battery belonging to the pre-War US Automated Aerospace Defense network is currently bombarding your Hellion. The installation is equipped with an automated defense-platform engine, numerous artillery pieces, and combat robots that must be destroyed to stop the bombardment.\n\nThis location can be reached using transport pods, shuttles, or a Hellion.
LanguageData.VGE_ActiveEnemyGravship.label: Enemy Hellion
LanguageData.VGE_ActiveEnemyGravship.description: An enemy Hellion: a versatile mid-sized aircraft powered by a standard Hellion engine and launched via a pilot console. Balanced in size and support, it can serve as a mobile base with sufficient upgrades and project power over long distances.\n\nThis location can be reached using transport pods, shuttles, or a Hellion.
